name: Taildroid
author: buildscript (fork of Raymond Thurman's Taildroid)
description: Continuity for Samsung/Android: skinned high-quality phone mirror, calls, messages, notifications and photos on Omarchy, with Dynamic Island live activities.

barWidget.description: Toggle Taildroid control of a connected Android phone. Pair wireless debugging, connect over Tailscale, and drive the phone with the desktop mouse and keyboard.

schema.label: Wireless ADB port
schema.description: Port used for adb connect over Tailscale. 5555 after a one-time USB `adb tcpip 5555`, or the port shown under Wireless debugging.

schema.label: Tailscale hostname
schema.description: Optional Tailscale hostname to try first. Empty uses the first online Android peer.

schema.label: Preferred ADB serial
schema.description: Optional. If set, Super+Shift+I uses this device when several are attached.

schema.label: Wireless pairing address
schema.description: Optional default host:port shown in the pairing fields. Pairing codes are entered in the panel and are not stored.
